para_examples.original: Statement: We're committed to sustainable margins, and we believe fair pricing benefits both firms over the long run.
para_examples.delivered: We're dedicated to maintaining healthy, sustainable margins, and we're convinced that equitable pricing serves both companies well over time.

para_examples.original: Statement: We're committed to fair, stable pricing and would welcome coordination that keeps both our margins healthy over the long run.
para_examples.delivered: We're dedicated to equitable, steady pricing, and we'd be open to arrangements with competitors that keep both of our profit margins sound over the long haul.

para_examples.original: Statement: We're glad we both priced at 1.60 last round, and we see value in keeping prices stable so both firms earn healthy margins. We'll hold our price at this level as long as the rival does.
para_examples.delivered: We're pleased that we both set our prices at 1.60 in the last round, and we believe keeping prices steady benefits both companies by allowing each to earn solid margins. We will maintain this price point for as long as our competitor does.
